content.title: WNBA Draft 2026 Live Coverage on SiriusXM NBA Radio (4/13/26)
content.text: The future of the WNBA takes center stage tonight in New York City. Starting at 7pm ET, SiriusXM NBA Radio (Ch. 86) on car radios and the SiriusXM app is your destination for live coverage of the 2026 WNBA Draft, bringing you inside the biggest night for the league’s next generation of stars. From the moment the first pick is announced, SiriusXM NBA Radio will deliver real-time analysis, expert breakdowns, and exclusive interviews with top prospects as they take the next step in their careers. Related: Zach Harper Hosts ‘Deals and Dunks’ on SiriusXM NBA Radio What to Expect SiriusXM NBA Radio will cover every moment of the draft, including: Live, pick-by-pick breakdowns as selections happen Interviews with top prospects moments after hearing their names called Expert analysis on team needs, roster fits, and draft strategy Immediate reactions from around the league Top Prospects to Watch This year’s class is deep — and notably unpredictable, with no consensus No. 1 pick heading into the night. Some of the biggest names expected to go early include: Lauren Betts (UCLA) – A dominant center coming off a championship run, widely considered one of the safest top picks. Azzi Fudd (UConn) – An elite scorer and one of the most recognizable names in the class, frequently projected near the top of mock drafts. Awa Fam (Valencia Basket) – A rising international star with size and versatility who could challenge for the No. 1 overall pick. Olivia Miles (TCU) – A dynamic playmaker with elite court vision who could anchor a WNBA backcourt immediately. Kiki Rice (UCLA) – A polished guard and floor general expected to factor into the top portion of the draft. Flau’Jae Johnson (LSU) – A versatile two-way guard with scoring upside and star potential. SiriusXM NBA Radio offers the best basketball talk and the biggest NBA games can all be found on one channel. The 24/7 channel delivers expert analysis and up-to-the-minute league news, from the NBA Draft through the NBA Finals. Listen as former players and coaches take your calls and address all the latest NBA news.
